<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 268.1939, which corresponds to a protonated molecule [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈267.1867 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 20 % of M) suggests about 16–18 carbons. A formula that matches the exact mass within a few millidaltons and fits the isotopic pattern is C₁₆H₂₇O₃ (calculated monoisotopic mass = 267.1960 Da, ≈ 9 mDa higher, i.e., ~35 ppm). This is the most plausible molecular formula for the compound.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H27O3</final_answer>
